description:
Token unlock schedules and supply metrics -- upcoming vesting cliffs and total supply movement per token. Heavy near-term unlocks are a supply-shock signal. Use it when the user asks about unlocks, vesting or supply overhang.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: get_token_unlocks
